content.value: Suppose first level and 2<sup>nd</sup> level MUX are constructed by the input channels of 20 and 5, respectively. If the channels are sampled at 8 kHz and the PCM frame are constructed with a framing bits in 1<sup>st</sup> level MUX and 17 overhead bits as control bits and stuff bits in 2<sup>nd</sup> level MUX. Calculate bit rate at the output of 1<sup>st</sup> level MUX and 2<sup>nd</sup> level MUX when each sample is quantized by 256 level quantizer.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
